last.verdict: Strong quarter, but weaker outlook and rising costs spooked investors.

reasons.label: Slower growth ahead
reasons.text: Apple guided September-quarter revenue growth of 9% to 11%, down from 16% now, citing supply limits.

reasons.label: Margins set to shrink
reasons.text: Gross margin guided to 47%–48% versus 50.1%, as tariff refunds fade and memory costs rise.

reasons.label: Services fell short
reasons.text: Services revenue grew 12% to $30.7 billion, slightly below analyst expectations.

story: Apple has guided for 13–17% growth in each of the last two reports and beaten it, but now guides 9–11%. Memory chip costs have grown as a worry. The stock rose after hours on the January and April reports, then fell 7.4% this time.
